ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) across approximately 95% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) clusters localized at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity region across the central fluke body; high-intensity geometric clusters are fixed at the distal margins of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle; lower vertex is partially obscured by water-level pixel noise.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations distributed continuously along the trailing edge from the medial notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters corresponding to barnacle colonies present on the upper-most distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of roughly parallel, curved light-colored linear marks (rake marks) are visible on the medial-superior region of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips; multiple linear rake-mark scars on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced irregular silhouette at the tips caused by the mass of accumulated barnacles.
